name: Jackie S.
words: Kelley is wonderful to work with. She did a ton of extras for us. Our purchase was based on two contingencies and we were out of state. There were multiple times where she kept the deal from falling through. We were so fortunate to have found her!

name: Kara G.
words: Kelley took us confidently through the journey of selling our first home and buying our second. She is professional, patient, and knowledgeable each step of the way and treated us like family.

name: Lauren B.
words: Kelley is out of this world. She was so unbelievably helpful and patient. She worked with us through our very first home buying experience and man, it was an experience! She spent countless hours walking houses with us, helped us navigate offers and stuck with us through a 3 month closing. Not to mention she helped save us when our original mortgage broker dropped us and is continuing to help us navigate homeownership even after closing. Kelley and her team are an absolute dream to work with and I can’t recommend her enough.

name: Ross B.
words: Where to begin… Kelley was absolutely incredible to work with from start to finish. We began working with her in January 2025 as first-time home buyers, particular, on a strict budget, and honestly a little nervous about the whole process. From day one, Kelley made us feel completely supported and understood. We probably walked through 50 homes with her, and not once did she show an ounce of frustration or impatience. Instead, she listened carefully, learned what really mattered to us, and ultimately found the perfect home for us. What really set Kelley apart was how she went above and beyond every step of the way. She guided us through a complex loan assumption process (something most agents rarely deal with) with complete confidence and professionalism. She handled every challenge during closing to make sure our interests were protected and that we felt comfortable throughout. Her communication was unmatched! She was always available to answer questions or calm our nerves, even while she was on vacation in Japan! That level of dedication is almost unheard of. We also hit a few bumps with our original mortgage lender, and Kelley immediately stepped in with her network of trusted professionals, connecting us with someone who turned out to be just as fantastic. She has an incredible roster of connections that make the entire process smoother and less stressful. There’s absolutely no way we would have gotten our home without Kelley. She’s patient, smart, deeply knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about her clients. If you’re buying or selling a home, especially if it’s your first time, do yourself a favor and call Kelley. You won’t find anyone better.
